hypothesis: A single bounded planner request produces a schema-valid, constraint-compliant, ready-for-review protocol from this complete brief.
baseline: Human-authored frozen brief and deterministic schema/constraint oracle; no claim of outperforming human research.
metric: All syntax and frozen-constraint checks pass (binary)
minimum_effect: Pass=1; otherwise stop planning route and preserve failure
replication: One integration attempt, not a statistical model-quality benchmark
uncertainty: No generalization or reliability claim from one response
